secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Flask session signing key. A development placeholder is set in .env.base44-defaults; override with a real value for persistent sessions.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI investment advisor/assessor features. Optional — the app runs without it; AI endpoints return graceful fallbacks.

secrets.name: BRAPI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Brapi.dev API key for premium dividend/quote data. Optional — a fallback token is hardcoded and yfinance is used as backup.
